title: Telnet is open
reason: Telnet lets people log in over the network. Without encryption, anyone who can see the traffic can read the password.

title: FTP is open
reason: FTP shares files over the network. Without encryption, anyone who can see the traffic can read the passwords and files.

title: Windows file sharing (SMB) is open
reason: This device shares files the Windows way (SMB). Shared folders are a common way for ransomware and intruders to spread from one device to the next.

title: Remote Desktop (RDP) is open
reason: Remote Desktop lets someone take full control of this computer's screen over the network. Attackers often try to guess its password.

title: VNC screen sharing is open
reason: VNC lets someone see and control this device's screen over the network. It is often set up with a weak password or none at all.

title: Docker remote control is open without encryption
reason: Docker's network control port is reachable without encryption. If access is unrestricted, people who can reach it may be able to control the host.

title: Redis database is open
reason: Redis is a database that often has no password. Anyone on your network may be able to read, change or wipe its data.

title: MongoDB database is open
reason: MongoDB is a database that is often left without a password. Anyone on your network may be able to read, change or wipe its data.

title: Elasticsearch is open
reason: Elasticsearch stores and searches data. If access is unrestricted, people who can reach this service may be able to read or delete its data.

title: Ollama model server is open
reason: Ollama is reachable over the network. If access is unrestricted, people who can reach it may be able to run requests or change the installed models.

title: AI model server exposes its model list
reason: The server returned its model list to a request without credentials. People who can reach this endpoint can see which models it lists.

title: SSH offers password login
reason: This device offers password authentication for SSH logins. Attackers can try password after password. Keys are much safer than passwords.
